title: POST /api/v1/internal/runner_relay/checks: the request body
description: runner-relay.md §8.2. A body that fails this schema is 422. Other fields are ignored: the relay and Rails deploy separately, so a newer relay must not be refused by an older platform. As in any JSON Schema, a number with no fractional part (7.0) is an integer.

machines.description: The machines to check; the answers come back in this order.

session_id.description: The session the relay believes the machine holds. Absent or `null`: none.
